smarter-golems.settings.title: Smarter Golems
The Copper Golem remembers the last item it picked up and looks for it again in the same copper chest during its next pickup cycle.
The Copper Golem remembers the chest where it deposited an item and skips the normal chest search when it picks up the same item again.
